title: SCRATCHY!!!
text: SCRATCHY!!!. I ordered NAVY. I fear that perhaps different colors are made differently. That *might* account for why these are like SANDPAPER, when others seem to love their sheets. I don't know. Perhaps it was just a bad batch. Google consumer reports on why higher thread count doesn't mean better sheets. These are probably the worst, SCRATCHY, sheets I've ever had. Will have to hunt for a new set...nice dark midnight blue color though, if that's all you're after.
